seed_ledger.name: Blackstone Inc: gas supply to its plants in development (group 2 of 2)
seed_ledger.reason: Foundry Ridge (324 MW, Darien WI): NOT_FOUND. Tied to data center load (We Energies purchase for data center load additions per advocacy and press coverage) but no source names the gas supply line or sponsor; PSC docket 9835-CE-100 lists on-site wells and the grid tie only. Wolf Summit (600 MW, WV): NOT_FOUND for pipe. Blackstone says the plant is partly meant for data center demand and is contracted to Old Dominion Electric Cooperative; only pipeline item is a 2024 county permission for Equitrans to survey for a gas line, no named project or length. Kindle Magnolia (LA): NO_DC_TIE, serves rural cooperatives. PNGC Kindle (Rathdrum ID): NOT_FOUND, no source found for this plant. North Royal (Deport TX): NO_DC_TIE, TCEQ notice describes a peaker, no pipeline or data center named. Searches run: 8. Sources: Blackstone press release (data center demand, no pipe), Harrison County commission notice (Equitrans survey), Wisconsin PSC docket page, WPR and UCS coverage (We Energies data center tie), TCEQ notice, power-eng Magnolia story.
